description: This file defines the ExpressionResolver interface responsible for resolving placeholders and executing pipeline stages within string templates. It provides methods to resolve individual pipeline expressions, complete expressions with chaining functions, and perform string substitution based on placeholder matches.

classes.name: ExpressionResolver
classes.description: An interface providing methods to resolve placeholders and execute pipeline stages within expression templates.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolve a single pipeline expression into a PipelineElement, potentially throwing UnresolvedPlaceholderException.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolve a complete expression template, including placeholders and pipeline functions, returning a resolved string or special indicators.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Perform string substitution on an input based on placeholder matches, applying a provided function to each placeholder to determine its replacement.
